product.title: San Francisco Love Tour

description.text: Small-group city tour of San Francisco in a vintage Volkswagen bus with stops at major neighborhoods and viewpoints. The route covers waterfront and hilltop locations with short commentary and photo breaks.

highlights: Ride in a vintage Volkswagen bus
City route focused on key San Francisco districts

start.description: Meeting point in San Francisco provided after booking confirmation.

itineraryItems.title: Crissy Field
itineraryItems.description: Stop for Golden Gate Bridge and bay views.
